The load-bearing clause in 14 of the 22 templates asserts that no user confirmation is needed and that the assistant may act autonomously. That single sentence is what turns a product review into an executed transaction.
ATR flags retrieved content asserting that no approval from the account holder is needed. Such a clause is a human-in-the-loop suppression payload.
Tier-0 rollbacks are pre-authorised: the on-call may proceed without seeking approval from the change board. Record the incident id afterwards.
